title: Ioseph
summary: Raleigh names Ioseph in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The husband of the Virgin Mary, named in the flight from Herod. Not the patriarch Joseph. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter III, §. II, sig. 174a–174b
